name: combobox
pattern: An editable single-select combobox combining the ARIA 1.2 Combobox Pattern with a listbox popup
responsibility: Provides the relationship between input and listbox, ARIA, the focus model through aria-activedescendant, keyboard operations, single selection, the IME guard, and state output; it does not generate, filter, display, or position options

targets.input: One native single-line <input> with data-combobox-target="input" inside the root
targets.listbox: One native <ul> or <ol> with data-combobox-target="listbox" inside the root
targets.option: A listbox descendant that is a native <li> with data-combobox-target="option". Each option has a non-empty, unique data-combobox-value

authorMarkup.label: The user provides the input's accessible name with a native label, aria-label, or aria-labelledby. The input's aria-controls relationship names the listbox
authorMarkup.validity: Markup is valid author markup when one root has exactly one input target and one listbox target, with options inside the listbox. Multiple selection, chip generation, grid/tree/dialog popups, and select-only comboboxes are outside the scope
authorMarkup.filtering: The user generates, filters, orders, and toggles hidden on options. The controller only uses visible and enabled options present in the DOM for keyboard operations and selection; it does not compare input text with option text
authorMarkup.nativeDatalist: A custom listbox is provided instead of native <datalist> because it needs option roles, selected/active state, keyboard support, and an event API. Using datalist at the same time is outside the scope
authorMarkup.content: The controller does not generate input, listbox, option, chip, or option content

semanticElements: The input must be a native single-line <input type="text"> or <input type="search">
The listbox must be a native <ul> or <ol>
Each option must be a listbox-descendant native <li> with a non-empty data-combobox-value
contractValidation.allowedRoles: The input role may be omitted or combobox, the listbox role may be omitted or listbox, and the option role may be omitted or option. Any other authored role violates the contract
contractValidation.invalidMarkup: On connection and target replacement, validate semanticElements, allowedRoles, option-value uniqueness, and the autocomplete value. When invalid, the controller does not apply listeners, ARIA, state, hidden, or focus operations and calls console.warn once per root while connected. It does not throw
contractValidation.warning: The warning includes the violating element type or role and the controller name. Validate again after the markup is repaired and reconnected

completion.warning: List completed attributes using "Added <attributes>. Include them in your markup." Warn once per connection using a flag separate from the enhancement-disabling warning.

value.description: Initial input value. Synchronize it as the selected option when it matches an option value

autocomplete.description: ARIA autocomplete. list represents list suggestions filtered by the user; none represents options independent of input text. both/inline are outside the scope

multiple.description: When true, selection is multiple. The role remains combobox, so treat this as a configuration difference of the same controller

selected.description: Multiple only. An array of option values selected initially. Ignore unknown values and ignore this value in single mode

value.description: The current input.value. The setter synchronizes input and selected state without changing events, focus, or filtering

open.description: The popup open state. The setter commits state without events or focus movement

selected.description: Multiple only. An array of selected option values. The setter synchronizes the selection set and state without dispatching an event, ignores unknown values, and does not change input.value. In single mode, the getter returns an empty array and the setter does nothing

show().description: Open the listbox programmatically. Do not change focus or events

hide().description: Close the listbox programmatically. Do not change focus or value, and do not dispatch an event

toggle().description: Toggle open programmatically. Do not change focus or events

select(value).description: Select a known enabled option value programmatically. In single mode, synchronize input.value and state as the selected value; in multiple mode, add it to the selection set without changing input.value. Do not change events, focus, or open

deselect(value).description: Multiple only. Remove value from the selection set, intended to be called by a user's chip removal button. Do not change events, focus, open, or input.value. Do nothing in single mode or for an unknown or unselected value

combobox:beforechange.when: Immediately before selection from a trusted option click or keyboard Enter

detail.value: The option value about to be committed (the toggled value in multiple mode)
detail.previousValue: The value before the change (single only)
detail.selected: Multiple only. The selection set about to be committed
detail.previousSelected: Multiple only. The selection set before the change

combobox:beforechange.effect: When preventDefault() is called, do not change input.value, the selection set, selected state, or the change event

combobox:change.when: After trusted option selection is committed

detail.value: The committed option value (the toggled value in multiple mode)
detail.previousValue: The value before the change (single only)
detail.selected: Multiple only. The committed selection set
detail.previousSelected: Multiple only. The selection set before the change

combobox:open.when: After the popup opens from trusted ArrowDown or ArrowUp

combobox:close.when: After the popup closes from trusted Escape

events.programmatic: The value/open/selected setters, show(), hide(), toggle(), select(value), deselect(value), input events, initialization, filtering, dynamic option synchronization, and disconnect/reconnect do not dispatch events
events.input: The controller does not cancel the user's input event and leaves input.value unchanged. Filtering and option display are the user's responsibility
events.synthetic: Treat keydown and click with isTrusted=false as non-user operations and do not change open, selection, or events

consumerIntegration.stimulusActions: Specify data-action="combobox:change->controller#method combobox:open->controller#method combobox:close->controller#method" on the root or an ancestor. Ordinary input/option actions can also be used; the controller does not stop event propagation
consumerIntegration.cancelableHook: To stop selection, call event.preventDefault() with data-action="combobox:beforechange->controller#method"
consumerIntegration.programmatic: Another controller can call value/open/show/hide/toggle/select through a Stimulus controller reference or outlets. The programmatic API and input event do not dispatch events
consumerIntegration.nested: When receiving events from a nested combobox outside, narrow them to your root with the data-action :self modifier or event.target === event.currentTarget

behavior.initial: Synchronize value value to input.value and open value to listbox hidden and ARIA. Add selected state only when value matches an existing option
behavior.filtering: The controller does not compare option text with input.value; it reads option hidden and aria-disabled to create the visible/enabled set
behavior.open: With input focused, trusted ArrowDown opens the popup and activates the first or next visible/enabled option after the current active option; ArrowUp activates the last or previous option. Dispatch the open event once with keyboard reason
behavior.initialMultiple: In multiple mode, synchronize selected value as the initial selection set. Initializing input.value from value value is the same in single and multiple modes
behavior.selection: A trusted option click selects the active option with pointer reason; Enter on the input does so with keyboard reason. An option with hidden or aria-disabled=true is excluded
behavior.escape: Escape while open closes the popup and preserves input focus and the current committed value. Dispatch close with keyboard reason. Escape while closed does nothing
behavior.tab: Tab does not prevent native focus movement from the input. The controller closes the popup after blur/focusout without dispatching an event
behavior.selectionModes: The default is single-select. When multiple value is true, selection is multiple; trusted click / Enter toggles selection, keeps the popup open, and does not change input.value. input is the filter field, while the user's chip markup (such as a removal button calling deselect(value)) displays and removes selections. The role remains combobox, so treat this as a configuration difference of the same controller. Do not implement chip generation or inline completion

input.ArrowDown: Activate the next visible/enabled option and open the popup if closed
input.ArrowUp: Activate the previous visible/enabled option and open the popup if closed
input.Home: Activate the first visible/enabled option only while the popup is open
input.End: Activate the last visible/enabled option only while the popup is open
input.Enter: Commit selection only when the popup is open and an active option exists. In multiple mode, toggle selection and keep the popup open
input.Escape: Close only while the popup is open

keyboard.option: Keep DOM focus on the input and represent the active option with the input's aria-activedescendant. Do not move focus to the option itself
keyboard.ime: During an IME-processing keydown (KeyboardEvent.isComposing, between compositionstart and compositionend, or keyCode 229), do not navigate, commit, or close with Arrow, Home, End, Enter, or Escape. Safari fires the IME commit Enter keydown after compositionend with isComposing=false / keyCode 229, so reject keyCode 229 before and after compositionend (the IME section of docs/notes/browser-engine-differences.md). Share detection in src/internal/ime.ts with listbox / tree typeahead
keyboard.optional: Alt+Arrow, typeahead, inline completion, and page navigation are outside the scope

focus.model: Use the ARIA activedescendant model and keep DOM focus on the input at all times
focus.active: Set input aria-activedescendant to the option ID only when an active option exists. Remove the attribute when none exists
focus.close: The controller does not change input focus when closing from Escape or focusout
focus.selection: Keep focus on the input after selection and do not change the caret position

input: Supplement role="combobox" only when role is missing
Synchronize aria-expanded with open state as controller-owned state output
Supplement the listbox ID only when aria-controls is missing
Synchronize aria-autocomplete with the autocomplete value
Supplement an ID that is unique within the document only when id is missing
listbox: Supplement role="listbox" only when role is missing
Supplement an ID that is unique within the document only when id is missing
Synchronize hidden with open state as controller-owned state output
Synchronize aria-multiselectable="true" only when multiple value is true (a value reflection; treat it like the listbox component and not as a completion-warning target)
option: Supplement role="option" only when role is missing
Supplement an ID that is unique within the document only when id is missing
Synchronize aria-selected, data-state, and tabindex as controller-owned state output
managedMarkup.preservation: Do not overwrite id, role, aria-label, aria-labelledby, aria-controls, aria-expanded, aria-autocomplete, aria-disabled, hidden, or other attributes authored earlier by the user. Synchronize controller-owned role completion, aria-expanded, aria-autocomplete, aria-activedescendant, aria-selected, hidden, data-state, and tabindex
managedMarkup.disabled: Use only option aria-disabled="true" and hidden to exclude an option. Do not add data-* for disabled

stateOutputs.ownership: root, input, and option data-state and input/listbox/option ARIA state are controller-owned. Preserve user values for input.value and option hidden
stateOutputs.option: In single mode, mark the visible/enabled option matching the committed value; in multiple mode, mark options in the selection set with aria-selected="true" and data-state="selected". Give the active option priority with data-state="active" and set other options to aria-selected="false", data-state="inactive". Set hidden or aria-disabled=true options to data-state="disabled" and aria-selected="false"

lifecycle: Register outside-focus listeners for input, listbox, option, and document in connect() and remove them in disconnect(). Do not register them twice after reconnection
Register compositionstart/compositionend, input, keydown, and click listeners in connect() and remove them in disconnect()
In disconnect(), do not run pending focusout/IME processing or dispatch events
Track added and removed input, listbox, and option targets with Stimulus TargetConnected/TargetDisconnected
When options change dynamically, retain the committed value if it remains; if the active option is removed, disable aria-activedescendant
Do not throw when a target is temporarily absent.

observations.environment: macOS Safari + VoiceOver and OS IME environments
observations.item: Input and option announcements, multiple selection, and IME confirmation Enter with keyCode 229
observations.impact: The contract fixes Combobox/Listbox semantics and IME suppression. The 229 guard has unit coverage; OS integration and wording remain compatibility observations, not verified browser-test results.

acceptanceCriteria: Required AAA criteria: 2.1.3 Keyboard (No Exception), with no pointer-only features; and 3.2.5 Change on Request, with controller focus movement limited to user actions or consumer JS calls, never timers.

The native input/list/option, roles, names, aria-controls, aria-expanded, aria-autocomplete, aria-activedescendant, and option state of an editable combobox (single / multiple) and listbox popup conform to the ARIA Combobox/Listbox Pattern and WCAG 2.2 Level AA

In multiple mode, aria-multiselectable and multiple aria-selected="true" values match the selection set; toggling selection leaves the popup open and input.value unchanged. Report multiple-selection announcements on a real screen reader as unverified
Detect authored roles that conflict with semantic HTML or combobox/listbox with console.warn and disabled enhancement
The controller does not own option generation, filtering, ordering, position, chips, or inline completion and uses the user's markup and filtering as-is
Synchronize keyboard movement among visible/enabled options and aria-activedescendant while keeping DOM focus on input
Suppress option navigation, commitment, and Escape for keydown during IME composition and from IME commit (keyCode 229), then return to ordinary processing for other keydowns

Safari's IME commit Enter (after compositionend / isComposing=false / keyCode 229) does not select an option. Because trusted keydowns with keyCode 229 cannot be produced in the combobox integration test, ime.ts unit tests and real-device checks cover it; record it as unverified when real-device verification is unavailable
Only trusted option selection dispatches one cancelable beforechange and one change after commitment; the programmatic API and input events dispatch no custom events
Opening with ArrowDown/ArrowUp, closing with Escape, and default Tab focus movement match the contract
Preserve existing IDs and ARIA attributes; generated IDs do not collide within the same document
Automated tests pass in Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit. Record engine differences for IME synthetic events as unverified
Report input, option navigation, selection, and announcements with macOS + Safari + VoiceOver as unverified if not performed

No events from initial value/open, the value setter, show/hide/toggle/select, input events, or the programmatic API

Navigation wrapping at the ends. Do not place the mutation that breaks listbox_navigation.ts's wrapping guard here because listbox-navigation-wrap-negative owns it
Guards for visible/hidden, aria-disabled, and enabled-option navigation
Detecting a missing input accessible name with a warning and disabled enhancement
Do not treat an untrusted synthetic keydown as a keyboard operation
Dynamic option addition/removal and active-state synchronization
beforechange cancellation, change detail, pointer/keyboard reason, and no event from a synthetic click

IME guards for compositionstart/compositionend and isComposing. The keyCode 229 guard cannot be tested in the integration test (a trusted keydown cannot carry 229), so ime.ts unit tests and real-device checks cover it
focusout, disconnect/reconnect, listener cleanup, and the native Tab focus path
Target isolation for nested combobox events
